sources.title: S1-mini: Open-Weights ASR Text Normalizer | KiaDev AI News
sources.snippet: Superwhisper has released the S1 model family: S1-Voice, S1-Language and S1-mini. The notable self-hostable component is S1-mini, a 0.6B open-weights text normalizer that runs after automatic speech recognition (ASR), converting raw transcripts into readable written text.
